pipeline.title: Roche builds blockbuster BTK case for fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis as FDA decision approaches
pipeline.summary: Roche has dived into the data behind its filing for FDA approval of fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis, unpacking the BTK inhibitor’s effect on chronic active lesions, disease control and brain volume.

pipeline.title: Cosette lands FDA approval for Evoxac liquid in Sjögren’s disease
pipeline.summary: The approval is for a liquid formulation of Evoxac, which was originally marketed by Daiichi Sankyo in capsules, providing an alternative treatment option for managing dry mouth symptoms in patients living with Sjögren’s disease.

pipeline.title: Advocacy organization launches data dashboard to better assess how clinical trial sites perform
pipeline.summary: The Society for Clinical Research Sites (SCRS) has launched a data intelligence platform to offer fresh insights into how different locations compare.

pipeline.title: Rapport's phase 2 bipolar win strikes chord with analysts despite falling short of original ambition
pipeline.summary: Rapport Therapeutics’ phase 2 bipolar mania study has hit its primary endpoint, furthering the biotech’s efforts to make RAP-219 a multiindication blockbuster. However, the effect size fell short of the level targeted by Rapport and analysts ahead of the readout.

pipeline.title: Veradermics' hot streak continues with another phase 3 win in hair loss
pipeline.summary: Topline results show the biotech's lead asset, VDPHL01, cleared all primary and secondary endpoints in a study of more than 500 men with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

pipeline.title: Pfizer makes ‘business decision’ to end phase 2 trial of autoimmune drug as program’s future uncertain
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has called time on a phase 2 trial of its CXCR5 antibody in an autoimmune blood disorder, with the company tight-lipped on whether this marks the end of the road for the asset.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca taps Oracle to help improve recruitment for clinical trials
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has turned to data giant Oracle as the U.K.-based Big Pharma works on one of the eternal problems of drug development—improving patient recruitment.

pipeline.title: Amgen, AZ dive deep into Tezspire's Dupixent-challenging victory in EoE phase 3
pipeline.summary: With little time elapsed since AstraZeneca and Amgen unveiled a topline win for Tezspire over the summer, the partners are upping the stakes with a detailed look at their inflammation-fighting antibody’s prowess in eosinophilic esophagitis.

pipeline.title: Disc’s once-spurned rare disease drug to get a second chance at approval
pipeline.summary: Months after the FDA rejected its treatment for a rare light-sensitivity disease, the biotech claimed success in a Phase 3 trial and now plans to re-engage regulators.

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA bets on RNAi with $1.3B Silence buyout
pipeline.summary: The acquisition gives the German company a promising blood disorder medicine that passed a Phase 2 test and could threaten a Takeda drug.

pipeline.title: Gilead ‘sitting on a foundational asset’ after oral UC drug's phase 2 win
pipeline.summary: Gilead touted a mid-stage win for its inflammatory bowel disease pill after the treatment delivered clinical improvements in patients with ulcerative colitis.

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA buys Silence in $1.3B deal after siRNA drug's phase 2 blood cancer win
pipeline.summary: Germany’s Merck KGaA has picked up Silence Therapeutics to the tune of $1.3 billion in the wake of the British biotech’s mid-stage success for its challenger to Takeda’s Mimrylo.

pipeline.title: Israeli biotech’s inhaled exosome therapy reduces respiratory failure in phase 2 study
pipeline.summary: Nano24’s inhaled exosome therapy reduced respiratory failure in patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), hitting the main goal of a phase 2b study.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly's Omvoh takes phase 3 win in pediatric UC, fueling expansion ambitions
pipeline.summary: A new positive phase 3 readout in kids with ulcerative colitis could help Lilly's Omvoh gain a competitive edge against its IL-23 rivals.

pipeline.title: GSK’s Jemperli scores FDA approval in rectal cancer, backed by high complete response rate
pipeline.summary: Building on the buzz around a celebrated early trial readout, GSK’s Jemperli has earned a first-in-class FDA approval in a specific type of rectal cancer.

pipeline.title: The Next Chapter for AI in Clinical Trials
pipeline.summary: As agentic AI enters clinical development, governance and human judgment will determine its value.

pipeline.title: Why Are 53% of Phase 2 and 3 Trials Delayed? A Redesign Is Overdue
pipeline.summary: A different model can improve quality, speed, and cost at once.

pipeline.title: AbbVie pumps up the economic case for early subcutaneous Parkinson’s treatment
pipeline.summary: Delaying the use of subcutaneous Parkinson’s disease treatments by one year increases annual medical costs by 59.1%, AbbVie-sponsored research found.

pipeline.title: Rebranded NodThera plans IPO to fund NLRP3 inhibitor’s push toward approval
pipeline.summary: NodThera—under its new name Rezera—is planning an IPO as the biotech steps up its ambitions to get its NLRP3 inhibitor to market.

pipeline.title: Roche’s CEO has ‘absolutely not’ changed tune on Poseida despite scrapping CAR-T from the buyout
pipeline.summary: Roche’s CEO has insisted to Fierce that the company’s view on its $1.5 billion Poseida buyout has “absolutely not” changed, even as the Swiss pharma scraps one of the CAR-T therapy’s from the acquisition.

pipeline.title: Otsuka hit with 11 marketing code breaches after event organizer blunder
pipeline.summary: The PMCPA has ruled that Otsuka Europe’s involvement with a sponsored symposium webpage breached 11 clauses of the U.K. marketing code. While the PMCPA found fault with many aspects of the webpage, the watchdog opted against hitting Otsuka with its toughest punishment.

pipeline.title: GSK, Ionis win US approval for first-of-its-kind hepatitis B drug
pipeline.summary: Hibsago is viewed as a potential “functional cure” for chronic infections and an important part of the British drugmaker’s goal of reaching £40 billion in annual revenue by 2031.

pipeline.title: Roivant, continuing ascent, claims another victory for rare disease drug
pipeline.summary: Shortly after winning a clearance in the skin disease dermatomyositis, brepocitinib posted results suggesting it might also be a “best-in-disease” medicine for an inflammatory eye condition, one analyst said.

pipeline.title: Direct-to-patient pharma programs transform drug access: survey
pipeline.summary: Many direct-to-patient programs have significantly affected access to medicines, a survey of U.S. life sciences leaders found.

pipeline.title: Arcus kidney cancer data impresses analysts; TriGemX inks a SPAC deal
pipeline.summary: New follow-up results suggest Arcus’ drug might be superior to a marketed Merck medicine. Elsewhere, Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca forged new partnerships.

pipeline.title: Alcon ponies up $550M for Neurotech, bagging approved cell therapy implant Encelto
pipeline.summary: Eye specialty pharma Alcon has bought out Neurotech Pharmaceuticals for $550 million, gaining access to the approved Encelto and Neurotech's proprietary cell-based gene therapy delivery platform.

pipeline.title: New US drug launches need price check to counter access impediments, ICER, West Health urge
pipeline.summary: As policies from the last two presidential administrations put heightened focus on drug affordability in the United States, a new report suggests much work remains to be done when it comes to the launch prices of novel medicines.

pipeline.title: CSL taps GSK’s Deborah Waterhouse as CEO in darkest hour
pipeline.summary: Recruiting an industry veteran to steer the company through its darkest hour of growth pressures, CSL has hired GSK’s Deborah Waterhouse as its next CEO.

pipeline.title: Amid bepirovirsen triumph, GSK quietly scraps trial of next-gen hep B therapy
pipeline.summary: GSK may have cemented its hepatitis B credentials with Tuesday’s landmark FDA nod for its “functional cure” bepirovirsen, but the pharma continues to rethink its strategy for next-gen candidates.

pipeline.title: Astellas links up with AI Proteins in $400M computational drug discovery deal
pipeline.summary: Japan's Astellas Pharma has tapped Boston computational discovery company AI Proteins in a drug discovery deal potentially worth $400 million.

pipeline.title: GSK brings promise of 'functional cure' to hepatitis B finish line with FDA nod for Hibsago
pipeline.summary: With the FDA’s green light in hepatitis B, GSK and its Ionis-licensed medicine bepirovirsen have racked up several notable distinctions, bringing the antisense oligonucleotide class to bear against the virus for the first time alongside the promise of functional cure-standard eff

pipeline.title: Biotech reverse mergers rebound to highest level since 2021 as PIPEs flood market: report
pipeline.summary: Reverse mergers have returned with a bang. More biotechs have taken the back door to the public markets so far in 2026 than in any full year since 2021, according to J.P. Morgan, with institutional investors backing many of the newly public companies from day one.

pipeline.title: Myriad Genetics to sell off Prenatal Health testing business to Labcorp
pipeline.summary: Myriad Genetics is selling off its Prenatal Health testing biz to Labcorp for $210 million in cash.

pipeline.title: Hologic snaps up Reveal Genomics to boost genomic diagnostic reach
pipeline.summary: Hologic is acquiring precision oncology company Reveal Genomics.

pipeline.title: FDA solidifies stance on mobile apps, software used with prescription drugs in final guidance
pipeline.summary: The agency clarified its framework for when drugmakers should include prescription drug apps in their labeling submissions or when app content should instead be treated as promotional material.

pipeline.title: ‘A two-way conversation with the tumor’: Researchers use ‘avatar’ to predict immunotherapy responses
pipeline.summary: Researchers have explored a revolutionary way to predict a patient's response to immunotherapies by creating a tumor “avatar” from biopsies.

pipeline.title: CDMO Samsung Bio wins temporary reprieve from strike threat after Seoul court ruling
pipeline.summary: Ahead of a planned strike by its labor union later this month, Samsung Biologics has secured a favorable South Korean court ruling that shields most of its drug substance manufacturing operations from the labor action.

pipeline.title: Rapport’s epilepsy drug finds surprising success in bipolar trial
pipeline.summary: Despite what some analysts described as low expectations, RAP-219 narrowly hit the main goal of a mid-stage study, results that could help it tap a billion-dollar-plus market opportunity.

pipeline.title: Most new drugs are still too costly at launch, ICER says
pipeline.summary: A new analysis from the non-profit group found that net launch prices for new medicines spiked significantly between 2022 and 2025, and the majority were well above its cost-effectiveness guidelines.

pipeline.title: Antheia lands $80M conditional loan from Trump administration to onshore drug manufacturing
pipeline.summary: The Department of War is allotting a conditional $80 million loan to next-gen ingredient maker Antheia, a move that will give the U.S. critical access to key starting materials and active pharmaceutical ingredients that are almost exclusively produced overseas.

pipeline.title: AbbVie hits the gas on immunology awareness with McLaren F1 pact
pipeline.summary: AbbVie has formed a multiyear deal with the McLaren Formula 1 team, signing up to raise awareness of immune-mediated diseases and provide funding for global charities.

pipeline.title: Hype vs. reality: What pharma’s hottest R&D bets have actually proved
pipeline.summary: New types of bispecifics, antibody-drug conjugates and cell therapies haven’t yet proven themselves in the clinic. Pharmaceutical companies are betting billions anyway.

pipeline.title: Lycia aims for $228M IPO to generate data on food allergy rival to Xolair
pipeline.summary: Lycia Therapeutics is banking on a $227.8 million IPO as the biotech seeks to finance its pipeline of protein degraders for autoimmune, inflammatory and allergic diseases.

pipeline.title: Industry at a ‘turning point’ with growth dominated by commercial leaders: EY report
pipeline.summary: A new report has found that in 2025 through the first half of 2026, innovation increased dealmaking and R&D investment, AI heavily influenced the future of value creation, and that industry growth continued to expand into alternative care settings.

pipeline.title: EyePoint cuts headcount, shifts priorities after another Duravyu AMD miss
pipeline.summary: In new topline results, EyePoint disclosed that its tyrosine kinase inhibitor Duravyu performed worse than Eylea in patients with wet AMD, compelling the pharma to drop its program in the indication and make significant staff cuts.

pipeline.title: Lilly partners with Hong Kong's Metis in $1.1B deal to bolster AI nanoparticle discovery
pipeline.summary: The collaboration is another in a series of partnerships Lilly has accumulated in both drug delivery and AI-based technologies.

pipeline.title: Investment firm TCGX picks migraine biotech TriGemX to take public via SPAC
pipeline.summary: Life sciences-focused investment firm TCGX will use a special purpose acquisition company to take migraine-minded TriGemX Bio public.

pipeline.title: Novartis pauses midstage Fabhalta trial in lupus nephritis—but efficacy, safety not at play
pipeline.summary: Amid a steady advance of kidney-focused label expansions, Novartis’ Fabhalta is slowing its roll in a key potential autoimmune niche.

pipeline.title: Roche pauses future Germany investments, joining growing chorus of pharma pullbacks
pipeline.summary: Amid tensions over government healthcare cost-cutting policies, Roche has slammed the brakes on new investments in Germany, joining an expanding group of drugmakers pulling back from the European country.

pipeline.title: Enlivex lays off 60% of employees, scraps preclinical R&D and gives execs ‘substantial’ salary cuts
pipeline.summary: Enlivex is laying off 60% of its workforce, ending preclinical R&D and trimming its top execs’ salaries as the Israeli biotech tries to keep cash flowing to its osteoarthritis drug.

pipeline.title: Roche inks $15B ADC pact with Hansoh; Veradermics scores in another baldness study
pipeline.summary: Roche is paying Hansoh $400 million up front in a broad deal involving several ADCs. Elsewhere, another top investor formed a China-focused fund and Ultragenyx sold a second review voucher.

pipeline.title: From strategy to scale: How Saudi Arabia is building a biotech ecosystem
pipeline.summary: Saudi Arabia’s biotech strategy now has named partners, sites and capital behind it.

pipeline.title: Ambrose Healthcare inks $181M deal for former Pfizer target AM-Pharma
pipeline.summary: Ambrose Healthcare has bought AM-Pharma for up to 161 million euros, inking a cut-price deal for a biotech once courted by Pfizer.

pipeline.title: ‘We’re getting back to stability’: CBER Director Karim Mikhail shares his strategy with Fierce
pipeline.summary: The FDA's Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER) is recovering from the most turbulent period in its recent history. The captain tasked with steadying the ship is Karim Mikhail, who was appointed as the center's director on a permanent basis last month.

pipeline.title: Hengrui has become the go-to source of China biopharma innovation. What’s its secret?
pipeline.summary: Amid the Chinese biotech licensing boom, Hengrui Pharmaceuticals stands out from the crowd. The Jiangsu-based biopharma landed one of the largest licensing deals ever by a Chinese company courtesy of a head-turning $15.2 billion biobucks pact with Bristol Myers Squibb in May. At

pipeline.title: AI-Powered Brand Sites Are Changing Patient Engagement
pipeline.summary: Compliant AI helps brands answer patient questions in real time and turn conversations into actionable insights.

pipeline.title: Closing the gap between approval and treatment
pipeline.summary: Lauren Boyer, CEO of Underscore, on why patient finding is a marketing job, and how to reach the people traditional data can't see.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: Viatris' Ryzumvi wins FDA nod in age-related vision loss
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Enlivex excises 60%; Eyepoint halves headcount
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.
